title: Lucky Drops
description: Every Block broken will trigger a random reward Compatible with Lucky Blocks Mod from Playerindistress
body:
# LuckyDrops Forge

### The Ultimate Lucky Block Addon

**LuckyDrops Forge** is an addon for the original **Lucky Block** mod by **PlayerInDistress (Alex Socha)**.

Instead of only opening Lucky Blocks, **every block you mine can become a Lucky Block**. Break stone, dirt, ores, logs, or almost any other block and experience the full Lucky Block reward system.

**LuckyDrops does not replace Lucky Block.**
It extends the original mod by making the entire world behave like Lucky Blocks while still using the original Lucky Block reward engine whenever possible.

**MAKE SURE TO CREDIT THE MOD WHEN USING IN VIDEOS**

---

## Features

* 🍀 Every mined block has a chance to trigger a Lucky Block reward.
* 🎁 Uses the original Lucky Block reward system.
* 💎 Supports Lucky Block loot tables and custom outcomes.
* 🏰 Structures, monsters, explosions, treasure, effects, commands, and everything the original Lucky Block can generate.
* ⚙️ Fully configurable trigger chance.
* 🚫 Configurable blacklist for blocks that should never trigger.
* 🎮 Optional Creative Mode support.
* 🔧 Lightweight and server-friendly.
* 🧩 Automatically detects the Lucky Block mod.
* 🛡 Safe fallback system if Lucky Block is missing (optional).

---

# Requirements

LuckyDrops **requires** the original **Lucky Block** mod by **PlayerInDistress**.

Download the original Lucky Block mod before installing LuckyDrops.

Minecraft Version:

* Forge 1.20.2

---

# Configuration

The configuration file is automatically generated:

```
config/luckydrops-common.toml
```

Available options include:

* Enable/Disable LuckyDrops
* Trigger chance
* Creative mode support
* Debug logging
* Prefer original Lucky Block rewards
* Optional fallback rewards
* Block blacklist

---

# Commands

## Reload the configuration

```
/luckydrops reload
```

Reloads the configuration file without restarting the game.

---

## Toggle LuckyDrops

```
/luckydrops toggle
```

Enable or disable LuckyDrops instantly.

---

## Enable

```
/luckydrops on
```

Turns LuckyDrops on.

---

## Disable

```
/luckydrops off
```

Turns LuckyDrops off.

---

## Debug Mode

```
/luckydrops debug
```

Toggles debug logging for troubleshooting.

---

## Status

```
/luckydrops status
```

Displays:

* Whether LuckyDrops is enabled
* Trigger chance
* Whether the Lucky Block mod is detected
* Current configuration
* Debug status

---

# How It Works

Normally, Lucky Block rewards only appear when opening a Lucky Block.

With LuckyDrops installed, breaking almost any block can trigger the Lucky Block reward system instead.

This means you can discover:

* Rare loot
* Valuable resources
* Dangerous traps
* Powerful monsters
* Massive explosions
* Random structures
* Lucky weapons
* Lucky potions
* Treasure
* Special events
* And everything else supported by the original Lucky Block mod.

Every mining session becomes completely unpredictable.

---

# Compatibility

LuckyDrops is designed specifically as an addon for the original Lucky Block mod.

Compatible with:

* Lucky Block by PlayerInDistress
* Forge 1.20.2
* Singleplayer
* Multiplayer servers

---
